All rows are evaluated at the proton pin q_0, the production default (local-substrate-q), and compared against the CODATA-2022 adjustment.

The \alpha^{-1}_{\mathrm{CS}} row is the Chern--Simons tower summed to all orders. The tower is geometric with ratio \delta_{\mathrm{CS}}\kappa \approx 2.7\times 10^{-3}, so it closes in the form 1 + \delta_{\mathrm{CS}}/(1 - \delta_{\mathrm{CS}}\kappa) and carries no truncation order to choose.

Superseded values, recorded so the change is legible. This table previously read \alpha^{-1}_{\mathrm{CS}} = 137.035944, CODATA 2018, residual 399 ppb. Those figures are the order-\delta_{\mathrm{CS}}^2 truncation evaluated at the muon pin against the superseded adjustment. Both moves are small and they act in the same direction:
